title: Plan Services Suspension and Plan Record End — Community Rules & Site Care
content:
A Community Rules & Site Care plan record is enrolled, has its plan services suspended, or has ended. The following governs suspension and the end of the record.

## Suspension

Plan services are suspended when the oldest unpaid plan fee has been unpaid for the plan's suspension figure, in days after its due day. The days are the calendar days, from its due day to the handling date, that the oldest plan fee not covered by payments has been unpaid, payments being applied to the oldest charge first; the figure is zero when every plan fee is paid.

While plan services are suspended, no plan fee is charged, the plan's upkeep is not performed, and every item becomes the resident's responsibility.

## Resumption

The former sentence "plan services resume on the day every past-due plan fee is paid, and plan fees resume from the next month" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for reinstatement.

## End of the record

The plan record ends on the day the site lease ends, whatever its status. The plan fee for the month in which the lease ends is still charged, and charges then owed stay due from the former resident.

## Hypothetical count of days unpaid

A record carries plan fees due 1 July, 1 August and 1 September, and a single payment that covers the July fee; no other charge is on the statement. The oldest unpaid fee is the one due 1 August.

| Handling date | Days the 1 August fee has been unpaid | Against a 60-day figure |
|---|---|---|
| 29 September | 59 | not reached |
| 30 September | 60 | reached: plan services are suspended |

## Hypothetical end of record

A lease ends on 18 November while the plan record is enrolled. The plan record ends on 18 November; the November plan fee is still charged, and the charges then owed stay due from the former resident.

superseded_clauses: Plan services resume on the day every past-due plan fee is paid, and plan fees resume from the next month.
